head: WORKTREE
summary: Skill covers the listed conventions, every rule matches current code (application.yml in both services, ClockConfiguration, package-private beans, controller/mapper/handler, ConstraintViolation gap in ledger, ArchUnit-enforced 500 fallback). All referenced paths exist. CLAUDE.md and java-hexagonal updated as asked.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: .claude/skills/spring-boot-conventions/SKILL.md has frontmatter and covers yml layout (no profiles, stated as such, file is application.yml), config/, generated *Api controllers, web mappers, handler mapping, 500 fallback, ConstraintViolationException, constructor injection, @Transactional at use case.

All 9 paths under Reference examples exist; spot-checked rules against both application.yml files, PaymentWebMapper (final, private ctor), InitiatePaymentService (Clock, @Transactional), ClockConfiguration (proxyBeanMethods=false), payment ProblemDetailsHandler:55, HexagonalArchitecture.java:304 (500 fallback rule); ledger gap documented as known divergence.
CLAUDE.md lists the skill under Skills and removes it from Growth; java-hexagonal SKILL.md links to it in one sentence without repeating content.

findings.description: Brief says application.yaml; skill correctly uses application.yml as in the code. Rule 12 (ledger 'should do the same') is a forward-looking recommendation, labelled as such, so acceptable.
